tools.name: search_roles
tools.description: Search open internships, co-ops and student jobs. Every argument is optional and they combine; a list matches any of its values. Newest first, except that roles with the query in their title or skills, and with more of the asked skills, come first. Returns the total, a page of roles (summary, places

tools.name: get_roles
tools.description: Everything about up to 5 roles by id from search_roles: all skills, majors, other boards and the employer's full posting text (hiring boilerplate left out), for checking a role against a resume or answering questions about it.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: The values search_roles filters by, each with how many open roles have it. show "overview" (default): types, fields, categories, majors, required languages, work terms and term lengths. show "companies", "skills" or "places", with an optional query, looks those up by name.
